what: Keeps the horizontal row of photo cells as is, and draws a WebGL panel in the same position and size, bending into a curved surface with the screen center receding (z −= cos(x / screen width · π) × half screen width × curve). When cells are moved or scaled with GSAP or scroll, the panel follows on every frame, and the curvature can also be changed with fx:curve — original is opening .2 · sentence .3 · gallery .05

options.curve: Curvature — multiplier on half the screen width, default .2 (0 is flat)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell (child) that becomes the plate — inside If there is an image, it covers and fills the slot, otherwise a placeholder showing data-label
options.fx:curve: Change the curvature with a CustomEvent(detail: number) on the element — via gsap { val } Tween this and send it from onUpdate, and the curvature changes smoothly
